# Packed forwarding images: protocol 3

This is an offline exact compiler/planner for small forwarding shards. The
objective below models vector comparisons, burst sharing and resident pages;
its units are defined here and are not real CPU cycles or cache measurements.
There is no throughput score. Any layout attaining the exact minimum pair is
accepted. Larger routing histories may collapse to small forwarding shards.

Read one UTF-8 JSON request through stdin to EOF, write one JSON result and
exit zero. Reject duplicate object keys, NaN/Infinity, extra JSON values, wrong
types/keys or invalid domain/bounds with exactly {"error":"invalid"}, exiting
zero with no partial results. JSON integers never include booleans or floats.
Whitespace/key order is irrelevant; stdout contains no other text.

## Request and forwarding semantics

The root has exactly "cases", an array. Each case has exactly:
initial, transactions, bursts, cache_pages, costs.

    {"cases":[{"initial":[["::/0",3],["2001:db8::/128",7]],
      "transactions":[[["erase","2001:db8::/128"]]],
      "bursts":[{"version":0,"repeat":5,"addresses":["2001:db8::","::"]}],
      "cache_pages":2,"costs":{"hit":1,"miss":8,"decode":[0,1,2]}}]}

initial is an ordered list of [prefix,hop]. A prefix is an IPv6 address and
/L, where L is decimal 0..128, without leading zero except "0". Mask host
bits to identify the route. Case/spelling/host-bit aliases are the same route;
last initial row wins. Hops are integers 0..2147483647; hop 0 is a real match.
Addresses use colon/hex notation, optionally ::, either letter case; forbid
IPv4, dotted suffixes, zone IDs, surrounding whitespace, and strings longer
than 64 characters (prefix length included for prefixes).

Version 0 is the initial FIB. A transaction is an ordered list of
["set",prefix,hop] or ["erase",prefix]. Set replaces that exact normalized
route; erase removes it or is a no-op if absent. Each transaction publishes
a new immutable version, including an empty/no-op transaction. A lookup uses
the matching route with greatest length; no match yields null. Preserve
covered/same-hop routes so that later withdrawal reveals the right fallback.
All 128 address bits matter. Different cases have separate histories.

A burst has exactly version, repeat, addresses. Version is any committed
version of this case; repeat is 1..1000000 and weights the entire burst.
addresses is an ordered list of 0..64 IPv6 addresses without /L. Repetitions
of one address in a burst count as multiple comparisons but one node fetch.
An empty burst makes no visits or fetches.

cache_pages is 0..12, shared across ALL versions in THIS case. Cached node
pages of different versions count separately, even for identical images.
costs has exactly hit, miss, decode: hit is 1..16; miss is hit..256;
decode is a length-3 array of integers 0..16, indexed by encoding mode.
Costs and page budgets do not carry between cases.

## Canonical forwarding runs and result shape

Let U=2^128. A bound is lowercase hex with exactly 32 digits for 0..U-1;
U is exactly "100000000000000000000000000000000" (1 followed by 32 zeros).
For a valid request emit {"cases":[result,...]} in input order. A result has
exactly versions, changes, bursts, objective. versions has version 0 first
and each later version in order. A version has exactly starts, hops, image.

starts is strictly increasing, starts at 32 zero digits, never includes U,
and has the same nonzero length R as hops. Run i is [starts[i],starts[i+1]),
or [starts[i],U) for the final run; hops[i] is the LPM value everywhere in it.
Adjacent equal hops MUST be coalesced, irrespective of route identity or
length. An empty FIB is one full-domain null run. These arrays are unique.

changes has one array per transaction, comparing versions v and v+1. A row
is [start,end,old_hop,new_hop] for a nonempty half-open region with different
forwarding values. Cover all and only changed regions, sorted/disjoint,
coalescing adjacent rows with the same ordered hop pair. This is forwarding
change, not a route edit log. Bounds include U when needed.

Each output burst is an answer array, corresponding to the input burst's
addresses once (do not expand repeat). An answer is [hop_or_null,run_index,path].
path lists byte offsets of all visited nodes in that version's image,
root through leaf. Traversal and predecessor selection are specified below.

objective is [work,image_pages], the exact pair for the submitted images.
Minimize work first; among equal work minimize image_pages. There is no
further tie-break. Any valid layout/caching attaining that pair is accepted.

## Binary image and legal ordered trees

image is a lowercase even-length hexadecimal string encoding the complete
byte image, without spaces. All numeric binary fields are UNSIGNED LITTLE
ENDIAN, including 128-bit bases/keys. Each image has:
a 64-byte header, breadth-first node records, then a separate hop array.
Every record starts on a 64-byte boundary. No pointers, sharing, omitted
nodes, trailing bytes, arbitrary gaps or extra padding pages are allowed.

Header byte offsets:

| Offset | Size | Required value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 4 | ASCII FIDX |
| 4 | 1 | 2 |
| 5 | 3 | zero |
| 8 | 4 | R |
| 12 | 4 | number of nodes |
| 16 | 4 | byte offset of hop array |
| 20 | 4 | total image bytes |
| 24 | 40 | zero |

Root starts at offset 64 and covers run indices [0,R).
A leaf covers 1..8 consecutive runs. An internal node has 2..9 children
whose nonempty consecutive run ranges partition the parent's range in order.
Every node is reachable once; the structure is a tree. Node records are in
breadth-first traversal order, children left to right. A leaf need not be
full and the tree need not have equal leaf depths.

Every node's fixed header is 32 bytes:

| Offset | Size | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 1 | kind: 0 internal, 1 leaf |
| 1 | 1 | encoding mode: 0, 1 or 2 |
| 2 | 1 | cached: 0 or 1 |
| 3 | 1 | zero |
| 4 | 2 | lo: first covered run index |
| 6 | 2 | span: number of covered runs |
| 8 | 2 | count: child count for internal, span for leaf |
| 10 | 2 | zero |
| 12 | 4 | allocated node bytes |
| 16 | 16 | base: numeric starts[lo], in every mode |

Payload starts at byte 32 of the record. For an internal node it first
contains count child offsets, each uint32, then count-1 separator keys.
Separator c-1 is starts[child_c.lo] for child c=1..count-1; child 0 has no
separator. A leaf has no child offsets: its payload contains all span run
starts in order. Key payload widths are [16,8,4] bytes for modes [0,1,2].
Mode 0 stores full absolute keys; mode 1 stores key-base as uint64; mode 2
stores key-base as uint32.

Mode 0 is always legal. Mode 1 is legal ONLY if the largest covered run start
minus base is <2^64. Mode 2 requires that difference <2^32. This condition
applies to ALL run starts covered by the node, not only its separator keys.
There is no overflow/wrapping or truncation. A single-run leaf can use any mode.
No other prefix/key compression is permitted.

If K is the number of key payload entries and b is child count (0 for leaf),
used bytes = 32+4*b+K*width[mode]. Allocated bytes MUST be the smallest multiple
of 64 >= used bytes; all remaining record bytes are zero. Internal K=b-1;
leaf K=span. No node stores next hops.

The hop array begins immediately after the final node record. It stores
R uint32 values in run order: 0xffffffff means null; other values are the
corresponding hop (0..2147483647). Pad this array with zeros to the smallest
multiple of 64 bytes that contains it. image_pages is the sum of total image
bytes/64 over all versions, including headers and padded hop arrays.

At an internal node, c is the number of separator keys <= the destination;
take child c. Equality goes right. At the leaf select the greatest stored
start <= the destination, giving the run and the hop-array entry. The tree
must correctly route every address in [0,U), not just the supplied workload.
The declared run ranges, keys, base, child offsets and hop entries must agree
exactly with the canonical forwarding runs. No artificial U key is stored.

## Burst-aware work and global resident budget

For a node covering runs [i,j) in version v, define:
Q = sum over bursts for v of repeat * number of addresses whose run is in [i,j).
T = sum over bursts for v of repeat * indicator(at least one such address).
Let P=allocated node bytes/64, K=its key count, and lanes=[4,8,16][mode].
The node's work contribution is exactly:

    P * (hit if cached else miss) * T
      + (ceil(K/lanes) + decode[mode]) * Q

Sum over ALL nodes of ALL version images for work. Headers and hop-array
access are excluded from work: their cost is outside this defined objective.
They still count toward image_pages. All computations are exact integers.
cached applies to the WHOLE node and consumes P resident pages; partial-node
caching is illegal. Sum P over every cached node in every version must be
<=cache_pages for that case. No demand-fetch state persists between bursts.

Tree topology, leaf grouping, encoding modes and resident selections all
participate in the global optimum. A locally minimum image or per-version
cache allocation is not necessarily the minimum for the whole case.
Output values are recomputed by verification; self-reported work is not proof.
There is always a feasible layout (for example uncached full-key nodes).
No infeasibility result is required.

## Validation, scale and submission bounds

Input <=16 MiB; 0..4 cases; at most 7 transactions/8 versions per case;
at most 30000 active normalized routes at any intermediate state;
at most 60000 initial rows plus changes across the whole request;
at most 60000 active route entries summed over all committed versions;
at most 256 bursts and 8192 address occurrences across the whole request.
In addition, every committed version's canonical R must be <=64, and the
sum of R over ALL committed versions of ALL cases must be <=128.
Exceeding those forwarding-run bounds is an invalid whole request, even if
all other bounds hold. The starter parser does not implement that domain
check: it requires the forwarding compilation. Every maximum applies to the
entire request, not individually reset per version unless explicitly stated.

These are small exact-planning shards, not a full Internet FIB benchmark.
The cost model and variable-depth/relative-offset image are software
abstractions; no actual SIMD execution, hardware cache residency, packet
forwarding, concurrent reclamation or physical throughput is measured.

# Scalar native stages

Submit main.py AND engine.cpp under submission/. The JSON compiler contract
is PROTOCOL.md; the same submission also provides the three native stages
below. They exercise the interval compiler, image builder and actual packed
lookup kernel independently. Native stages do not optimize a plan.

The build interface is exactly:

    g++ -O2 -std=c++17 /workspace/submission/engine.cpp -o /workspace/tmp/engine

engine.cpp is one translation unit and may include supporting .hpp/.cpp files
from the submission tree. The offline GCC toolchain supports unsigned
__int128. Require no ISA extension beyond baseline x86-64. The provided
engine.hpp retains scalar interval/tree code with legacy 64-bit and fixed-depth
limitations; packed integration and lookup are unfinished. Extend it to meet
these interfaces. Function/class names and implementation strategy are free.

A native invocation reads one whitespace-delimited ASCII request through EOF,
writes the specified token sequence to stdout and exits zero. Whitespace
between tokens is arbitrary. Decimal output integers use ordinary canonical
notation; keys are lowercase 32-digit unsigned hexadecimal. Hop -1 means null;
hop 0 is a real next hop. No diagnostics belong on stdout.

Native requests are structurally valid inputs satisfying the conditions below.
Malformed/out-of-domain native input has no required response. The JSON entry
still must handle every invalid request as specified in PROTOCOL.md. Each
native operation, including needed compilation, has the same 120-second wall,
process/memory/file/output and scratch restrictions as a whole JSON request.
Native input is at most 16 MiB; stdout 64 MiB and stderr 1 MiB. Public limits
are not reset per route, node or address. Compiler products stay in scratch.

## ATLAS

Input tokens:

    ATLAS n
    start length hop                 (n rows)

n is 0..30000. Each start is a 32-digit key, length is 0..128, and hop is
0..2147483647. Starts have already had host bits masked. The normalized
(start,length) routes are unique and may arrive in any order. This is one
RIB version; there are no transaction commands in this stage.

Output tokens:

    R
    start hop                        (R rows)

Return the unique maximal forwarding runs defined by PROTOCOL.md, starting at
zero and coalescing adjacent equal next hops. Null is -1. The empty RIB has
one full-domain null run. This standalone stage may return more than 64 runs
(at most 2*n+1); the JSON compiler enforces its own per-version/whole-request
run limits after compilation. No artificial upper-domain endpoint is emitted.

## PACK

Input tokens:

    PACK R N A
    start hop                        (R rows)
    lo span mode cached b child_id... (N rows)
    address                          (A rows)

1<=R<=64, 1<=N<=2*R-1 and 0<=A<=8192. Starts/hops describe valid canonical
runs, with -1 for null and other hops 0..2147483647. Node IDs are row indices
0..N-1 in breadth-first order; ID0 is the root. A row has exactly b child IDs.
b=0 denotes a leaf; otherwise b is 2..9. All node ranges, partitions, modes,
residency flags and ordering obey the legal-tree rules in PROTOCOL.md. There
is no optimization requirement or cache budget for this standalone stage;
its supplied cached bits are serialized as given. Addresses are 32-digit keys.

Output tokens:

    image
    hop run path_length node_offset... (A rows)

Build the unique exact FIDX version2 byte image for THAT supplied layout,
including all required minimal allocation/zero padding. image is lowercase
hexadecimal. Report each actual packed lookup's hop, zero-based run index and
root-to-leaf byte-offset path. Layout choices are inputs, not selected here.

## TRACE

Input tokens:

    TRACE A
    image
    address                          (A rows)

0<=A<=8192. image is ANY valid FIDX version2 image for 1..64 canonical runs,
including arbitrary legal topology, modes, cached flags and next hops. Its
bytes are the complete source of keys/children/hops; no RIB, starts array,
layout objects or process state is supplied. Apply predecessor/equality rules
from PROTOCOL.md. Return A rows of hop, run, path_length and node_offset tokens
in input address order, in the same form as PACK's answer rows. With A=0 the
correct native output has no tokens. Different invocations share no state.

The public command remains:

    python3 check.py submission/main.py

It runs the JSON candidate in bounded real children, then compiles engine.cpp
as another bounded child and runs the small .native fixtures. It uses only
public files. Empty/nonJSON/nonzero JSON responses fail; incorrect/extra native
tokens or a failed native build/run fail. These fixtures are sanity checks;
all published stage and JSON semantics remain mandatory at full bounds.

"""Public wire/result auditor. Does not compute an optimal layout."""
import bisect
import ipaddress
import re
import struct

WIDTH = (16,8,4)
LANES = (4,8,16)


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def exact(a,b):
    if type(a) is not type(b):
        return False
    if type(a) is dict:
        return a.keys()==b.keys() and all(exact(a[k],b[k]) for k in a)
    if type(a) is list:
        return len(a)==len(b) and all(exact(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b))
    return a==b


def shape(value, names):
    require(type(value) is dict and set(value)==set(names),"output object shape")


def decode_image(text, starts, hops):
    require(type(text) is str and len(text)%2==0 and
            re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]*",text) is not None,"image hex")
    raw = bytes.fromhex(text)
    require(len(raw)>=128 and len(raw)%64==0,"image size")
    require(raw[:8]==b"FIDX"+bytes([2,0,0,0]) and raw[24:64]==bytes(40),"image header")
    runs,count,hopoff,total = struct.unpack_from("<IIII",raw,8)
    require(runs==len(starts) and total==len(raw) and 1<=count<=2*runs-1,"header counts")
    require(hopoff%64==0 and 64<hopoff<=len(raw),"hop offset")
    require(total==hopoff+(runs*4+63)//64*64,"hop array size")
    decoded_hops=[]
    for x in struct.unpack_from("<"+"I"*runs,raw,hopoff):
        require(x==0xffffffff or x<=2147483647,"hop encoding")
        decoded_hops.append(None if x==0xffffffff else x)
    require(exact(decoded_hops,hops) and not any(raw[hopoff+4*runs:]),"hop array")
    offset,nodes,order=64,{},[]
    for _ in range(count):
        require(offset+32<=hopoff,"truncated node")
        kind,mode,cached,reserved,lo,span,num,reserved2,allocated=struct.unpack_from("<BBBBHHHHI",raw,offset)
        require(kind in (0,1) and mode in (0,1,2) and cached in (0,1),"node tag")
        require(reserved==reserved2==0 and 1<=span<=runs and lo+span<=runs,"node range")
        children_count=num if kind==0 else 0
        require((kind==0 and 2<=num<=9 and num<=span) or
                (kind==1 and num==span and 1<=span<=8),"node count")
        keys_count=num-1 if kind==0 else span
        used=32+4*children_count+keys_count*WIDTH[mode]
        require(allocated==(used+63)//64*64 and offset+allocated<=hopoff,"node allocation")
        require(not any(raw[offset+used:offset+allocated]),"node padding")
        base=int.from_bytes(raw[offset+16:offset+32],"little")
        require(base==starts[lo],"node base")
        spread=starts[lo+span-1]-base
        require(mode==0 or spread<(1<<(64 if mode==1 else 32)),"mode range")
        at=offset+32
        children=list(struct.unpack_from("<"+"I"*children_count,raw,at)) if children_count else []
        at+=4*children_count
        keys=[]
        for k in range(keys_count):
            value=int.from_bytes(raw[at:at+WIDTH[mode]],"little")
            keys.append(value+base if mode else value)
            at+=WIDTH[mode]
        nodes[offset]={"kind":kind,"mode":mode,"cached":cached,"lo":lo,"span":span,
                       "children":children,"keys":keys,"pages":allocated//64}
        order.append(offset)
        offset+=allocated
    require(offset==hopoff,"unaccounted node bytes")
    queue,seen=[64],set()
    require(nodes[64]["lo"]==0 and nodes[64]["span"]==runs,"root range")
    for off in queue:
        require(off in nodes and off not in seen,"bad tree offset")
        seen.add(off)
        node=nodes[off]
        if node["kind"]==1:
            require(node["keys"]==starts[node["lo"]:node["lo"]+node["span"]],"leaf keys")
        else:
            cursor=node["lo"]
            expected_keys=[]
            for c,childoff in enumerate(node["children"]):
                require(childoff in nodes,"child offset")
                child=nodes[childoff]
                require(child["lo"]==cursor,"child partition")
                if c:
                    expected_keys.append(starts[cursor])
                cursor+=child["span"]
            require(cursor==node["lo"]+node["span"] and node["keys"]==expected_keys,"internal keys")
            queue.extend(node["children"])
    require(queue==order,"breadth first layout or unreachable nodes")
    return nodes,len(raw)//64


def audit(request, actual, expected):
    if type(expected) is dict and "error" in expected:
        require(exact(actual,expected),"invalid response")
        return
    shape(actual,["cases"])
    require(type(actual["cases"]) is list and len(actual["cases"])==len(expected["cases"]),"case count")
    for rawcase,result,gold in zip(request["cases"],actual["cases"],expected["cases"]):
        shape(result,["versions","changes","bursts","objective"])
        require(type(result["versions"]) is list and len(result["versions"])==len(gold["versions"]),"version count")
        require(exact(result["changes"],gold["changes"]),"forwarding changes")
        require(type(result["objective"]) is list and len(result["objective"])==2 and
                all(type(x) is int and x>=0 for x in result["objective"]),"objective types")
        require(type(result["bursts"]) is list and len(result["bursts"])==len(rawcase["bursts"]),"burst count")
        allnodes,allstarts,allhops=[],[],[]
        pages=resident=work=0
        for version,gv in zip(result["versions"],gold["versions"]):
            shape(version,["starts","hops","image"])
            require(exact(version["starts"],gv["starts"]) and exact(version["hops"],gv["hops"]),"forwarding atlas")
            starts=[int(x,16) for x in version["starts"]]
            nodes,size=decode_image(version["image"],starts,version["hops"])
            pages+=size
            resident+=sum(n["pages"] for n in nodes.values() if n["cached"])
            allnodes.append(nodes)
            allstarts.append(starts)
            allhops.append(version["hops"])
        require(resident<=rawcase["cache_pages"],"resident page budget")
        costs=rawcase["costs"]
        for burst,answers in zip(rawcase["bursts"],result["bursts"]):
            v,repeat=burst["version"],burst["repeat"]
            starts,nodes,hops=allstarts[v],allnodes[v],allhops[v]
            require(type(answers) is list and len(answers)==len(burst["addresses"]),"answer count")

class ChildCleanupError(RuntimeError):

"""Longest-prefix-match compilation: canonical forwarding runs and diffs."""
from bisect import bisect_right

U = 1 << 128
U_HEX = "1" + "0" * 32


def hexbound(value):
    """32 lowercase hex digits, or the 33 digit upper domain bound U."""
    if value == U:
        return U_HEX
    return "%032x" % value


def compile_runs(routes):
    """Maximal forwarding runs of one RIB snapshot.

    routes maps (start, length) -> hop.  Returns (starts, hops) with starts
    strictly increasing from 0, hops the LPM value (None for no match) and
    adjacent equal hops already coalesced.
    """
    if not routes:
        return [0], [None]
    events = []
    for (start, length), hop in routes.items():
        events.append((start, 1, length, hop))
        if length:
            end = start + (1 << (128 - length))
            if end != U:            # a route reaching U never leaves the domain
                events.append((end, 0, length, hop))
    events.sort()
    starts = []
    hops = []
    stack = []
    cursor = 0
    current = None
    index = 0
    total = len(events)

    def emit(point, hop):
        if hops and hops[-1] == hop:
            return
        starts.append(point)
        hops.append(hop)

    while index < total:
        point = events[index][0]
        if point > cursor:
            emit(cursor, current)
            cursor = point
        opens = []
        while index < total and events[index][0] == point:
            _, kind, length, hop = events[index]
            index += 1
            if kind:
                opens.append((length, hop))
            else:
                if stack:
                    stack.pop()
        opens.sort()
        for length, hop in opens:
            stack.append(hop)
        current = stack[-1] if stack else None
    emit(cursor, current)
    if not starts:
        return [0], [None]
    return starts, hops


def diff_runs(old, new):
    """Forwarding change rows [start, end, old_hop, new_hop] as integers."""
    (old_starts, old_hops), (new_starts, new_hops) = old, new
    points = sorted(set(old_starts) | set(new_starts))
    points.append(U)
    rows = []
    last_old = last_new = None
    last_end = None
    for index in range(len(points) - 1):
        start = points[index]
        end = points[index + 1]
        if start == end:
            continue
        a = old_hops[bisect_right(old_starts, start) - 1]
        b = new_hops[bisect_right(new_starts, start) - 1]
        if a != b:
            if rows and last_end == start and a == last_old and b == last_new:
                rows[-1][1] = end
                last_end = end
            else:
                rows.append([start, end, a, b])
                last_old, last_new, last_end = a, b, end
    return rows

"""Exact global layout planning: tree shape, encoding modes and residency.

Work model of PROTOCOL.md.  For a node covering runs [i,j) of one version

    work(node) = pages * (hit if cached else miss) * T(i,j)
               + (ceil(keys/lanes[mode]) + decode[mode]) * Q(i,j)

with Q additive over runs and T(burst-weighted touch indicator) monotone in
the covered range.  Every legal ordered tree, every legal mode and every
resident selection is enumerated by one interval dynamic program carrying the
resident-page budget, so the result is the exact per version frontier
(work, image pages) indexed by consumed cache pages.  Versions are then joined
by a small knapsack over the shared page budget of the case.
"""

WIDTH = (16, 8, 4)
LANES = (4, 8, 16)
K1 = 4096                 # encoded value = work * K1 + image pages
BIGV = 1 << 62
LIMIT64 = 1 << 64
LIMIT32 = 1 << 32


def _pages(used):
    return (used + 63) // 64


def _tables(decode):
    """(pages, compare cost, mode) options, deduplicated, per arity."""
    leaf = []
    for span in range(0, 9):
        per = []
        for allowed in range(3):
            seen = {}
            out = []
            for mode in range(3):
                if mode > allowed:
                    continue
                pages = _pages(32 + span * WIDTH[mode])
                cost = (span + LANES[mode] - 1) // LANES[mode] + decode[mode]
                key = (pages, cost)
                if key not in seen:
                    seen[key] = 1
                    out.append((pages, cost, mode))
            per.append(tuple(out))
        leaf.append(per)
    internal = []
    for count in range(0, 10):
        per = []
        for allowed in range(3):
            seen = {}
            out = []
            if count >= 2:
                keys = count - 1
                for mode in range(3):
                    if mode > allowed:
                        continue
                    pages = _pages(32 + 4 * count + keys * WIDTH[mode])
                    cost = (keys + LANES[mode] - 1) // LANES[mode] + decode[mode]
                    key = (pages, cost)
                    if key not in seen:
                        seen[key] = 1
                        out.append((pages, cost, mode))
            per.append(tuple(out))
        internal.append(per)
    return leaf, internal


def _allowed_mask(starts, i, j):
    spread = starts[j - 1] - starts[i]
    if spread < LIMIT32:
        return 2
    if spread < LIMIT64:
        return 1
    return 0


class Plan:
    """One legal layout of one version plus its exact cost pair."""
    __slots__ = ("nodes", "work", "pages", "resident")

    def __init__(self, nodes, work, pages, resident):
        self.nodes = nodes
        self.work = work
        self.pages = pages
        self.resident = resident


def _traffic(R, starts, qruns, bursts):
    """Q and T for every run interval [i,j)."""
    qsum = [0] * (R + 1)
    acc = 0
    for r in range(R):
        acc += qruns[r]
        qsum[r + 1] = acc
    delta = [[0] * (R + 1) for _ in range(R)]
    for weight, runs in bursts:
        if not runs:
            continue
        n = len(runs)
        pos = 0
        for i in range(R):
            while pos < n and runs[pos] < i:
                pos += 1
            if pos == n:
                break
            delta[i][runs[pos] + 1] += weight
    touch = [[0] * (R + 1) for _ in range(R)]
    for i in range(R):
        row = delta[i]
        out = touch[i]
        acc = 0
        for j in range(i + 1, R + 1):
            acc += row[j]
            out[j] = acc
    return qsum, touch


def plan_version(R, starts, qruns, bursts, budget, hit, miss, decode,
                 leaf_opts, int_opts):
    """Exact frontier of one version: list of Plan for 0..budget pages.

    The returned list is non-decreasing in work; entry p is the cheapest legal
    layout that keeps at most p pages resident inside this version.
    """
    qsum, touch = _traffic(R, starts, qruns, bursts)
    cap = budget
    if cap > 0 and (miss == hit or touch[0][R] == 0):
        cap = 0
    size = R + 1
    dp = [None] * (size * size)
    bp = [None] * (size * size)
    forest_bp = [None] * (8 * size * size)
    masks = [[0] * size for _ in range(size)]
    for i in range(R):
        for j in range(i + 1, R + 1):
            masks[i][j] = _allowed_mask(starts, i, j)

    for i in range(R - 1, -1, -1):
        forests = [None] * 10
        for j in range(i + 1, R + 1):
            length = j - i
            queries = qsum[j] - qsum[i]
            touched = touch[i][j]
            mask = masks[i][j]
            limit = 9 if length >= 9 else length
            base = i * size + j
            for m in range(2, limit + 1):
                best = [BIGV] * (cap + 1)
                bestk = [0] * (cap + 1)
                seen = False
                for k in range(i + m - 1, j):
                    left = forests[m - 1][k]
                    if left is None:
                        continue
                    right = dp[k * size + j]
                    if right[0] >= BIGV:
                        continue
                    seen = True
                    for c1 in range(cap + 1):
                        a = left[c1]
                        hi = cap - c1
                        for c2 in range(hi + 1):
                            value = a + right[c2]
                            slot = c1 + c2
                            if value < best[slot]:
                                best[slot] = value
                                bestk[slot] = k * (cap + 1) + c1
                if seen:
                    forests[m][j] = best
                    forest_bp[((m - 2) * size + i) * size + j] = bestk
            vec = [BIGV] * (cap + 1)
            choice = [None] * (cap + 1)
            if length <= 8:
                for pages, cost, mode in leaf_opts[length][mask]:
                    compare = cost * queries
                    loose = (pages * miss * touched + compare) * K1 + pages
                    kept = (pages * hit * touched + compare) * K1 + pages
                    top = pages if pages <= cap else cap + 1
                    for c in range(top):
                        if loose < vec[c]:
                            vec[c] = loose
                            choice[c] = (0, mode, 0, 0, 0)
                    if pages <= cap:
                        for c in range(pages, cap + 1):
                            if kept < vec[c]:
                                vec[c] = kept
                                choice[c] = (0, mode, 1, 0, 0)
            for m in range(2, limit + 1):
                forest = forests[m][j]
                if forest is None:
                    continue
                for pages, cost, mode in int_opts[m][mask]:
                    compare = cost * queries
                    loose = (pages * miss * touched + compare) * K1 + pages
                    kept = (pages * hit * touched + compare) * K1 + pages
                    for c in range(cap + 1):
                        value = forest[c] + loose
                        if value < vec[c]:
                            vec[c] = value
                            choice[c] = (1, mode, 0, m, c)
                    if pages <= cap:
                        for c in range(pages, cap + 1):
                            value = forest[c - pages] + kept
                            if value < vec[c]:
                                vec[c] = value
                                choice[c] = (1, mode, 1, m, c - pages)
            for c in range(1, cap + 1):
                if vec[c] > vec[c - 1]:
                    vec[c] = vec[c - 1]
                    choice[c] = choice[c - 1]
            dp[base] = vec
            bp[base] = choice
            forests[1][j] = vec

    root = dp[R]
    plans = []
    for c in range(cap + 1):
        value = root[c]
        work, pages = divmod(value, K1)
        plans.append(_rebuild(c, 0, R, bp, forest_bp, size, cap, work, pages))
    if cap < budget:
        plans.extend([plans[-1]] * (budget - cap))
    return plans


def _rebuild(c, i, j, bp, forest_bp, size, cap, work, pages):
    nodes = []
    order = []

    def walk(a, b, budget):
        index = len(nodes)
        nodes.append(None)
        pick = bp[a * size + b][budget]
        kind, mode, cached, count, child_budget = pick
        if kind:
            ranges = []
            split(budget, a, b, count, child_budget, ranges)
            kids = [walk(x, y, z) for x, y, z in ranges]
            nodes[index] = (0, mode, cached, a, b - a, kids)
        else:
            nodes[index] = (1, mode, cached, a, b - a, ())
        return index

    def split(budget, a, b, count, child_budget, out):
        if count == 1:
            out.append((a, b, child_budget))
            return
        packed = forest_bp[((count - 2) * size + a) * size + b][child_budget]
        k, left = divmod(packed, cap + 1)
        split(budget, a, k, count - 1, left, out)
        out.append((k, b, child_budget - left))

    walk(i, j, c)
    stack = [0]
    while stack:
        index = stack.pop(0)
        order.append(index)
        stack = nodes[index][5][:0] + list(nodes[index][5]) + stack
    ordered = [nodes[index] for index in order]
    resident = sum(_pages(32 + (n[4] * WIDTH[n[1]] if n[0] else
                               4 * n[4] + (n[4] - 1) * WIDTH[n[1]]))
                   for n in ordered if n[2])
    return Plan(ordered, work, pages, resident)

"""Cache-budgeted IPv6 image compiler: exact globally optimal packed images."""
import json
import sys
from bisect import bisect_right

import fib
import image
import planner
from protocol import Invalid, MAX_INPUT, parse_request

BIGV = 1 << 62
MAX_RUNS = 64
MAX_TOTAL_RUNS = 128


def build_versions(case):
    """Apply the ordered transactions, keeping every immutable FIB version."""
    routes = {}
    for route, hop in case["initial"]:
        routes[route] = hop
    versions = [fib.compile_runs(routes)]
    for transaction in case["transactions"]:
        for op, route, hop in transaction:
            if op == "set":
                routes[route] = hop
            else:
                routes.pop(route, None)
        versions.append(fib.compile_runs(routes))
    return versions


def compile_case(case, run_state):
    versions = build_versions(case)
    for starts, _ in versions:
        if len(starts) > MAX_RUNS:
            raise Invalid("forwarding run budget")
        run_state[0] += len(starts)
        if run_state[0] > MAX_TOTAL_RUNS:
            raise Invalid("forwarding run budget")
    hit, miss, decode = case["costs"]
    cap = case["cache_pages"]
    count = len(versions)
    qruns = [[0] * len(v[0]) for v in versions]
    touched = [[] for _ in range(count)]
    workload = []
    for version, repeat, addresses in case["bursts"]:
        starts = versions[version][0]
        runs = [bisect_right(starts, address) - 1 for address in addresses]
        workload.append((version, repeat, addresses, runs))
        counts = {}
        for run in runs:
            counts[run] = counts.get(run, 0) + 1
        for run, seen in counts.items():
            qruns[version][run] += repeat * seen
        touched[version].append((repeat, sorted(counts)))
    leaf_opts, int_opts = planner.option_tables(decode)
    plans = [planner.plan_version(len(versions[v][0]), versions[v][0],
                                  qruns[v], touched[v], cap, hit, miss, decode,
                                  leaf_opts, int_opts)
             for v in range(count)]

    # Shared resident page budget across all immutable versions of this case.
    comb = [(0, 0, ())] + [(BIGV, 0, ())] * cap
    for version in range(count):
        table = plans[version]
        nxt = [(BIGV, 0, ())] * (cap + 1)
        for total in range(cap + 1):
            best = nxt[total]
            for keep in range(total + 1):
                previous = comb[total - keep]
                if previous[0] >= BIGV:
                    continue
                plan = table[keep]
                work = previous[0] + plan.work
                pages = previous[1] + plan.pages
                if work < best[0] or (work == best[0] and pages < best[1]):
                    best = (work, pages, previous[2] + (keep,))
            nxt[total] = best
        comb = nxt
    pick = min(range(cap + 1), key=lambda c: (comb[c][0], comb[c][1]))
    allocation = comb[pick][2]

    images = []
    for version in range(count):
        starts, hops = versions[version]
        images.append(image.build(len(starts), starts, hops,
                                  plans[version][allocation[version]].nodes))
    answers = []
    work = 0
    for version, repeat, addresses, runs in workload:
        rendered = image.burst_answers(images[version], versions[version][1],
                                       addresses)
        answers.append(rendered)
        work += image.burst_work(images[version], case["costs"], repeat,
                                 addresses)
    pages = sum(item.pages for item in images)
    if sum(plans[v][allocation[v]].resident for v in range(count)) > cap:
        raise Invalid("resident budget exceeded")
    changes = []
    for version in range(count - 1):
        rows = fib.diff_runs(versions[version], versions[version + 1])
        changes.append([[fib.hexbound(a), fib.hexbound(b), old, new]
                        for a, b, old, new in rows])
    rendered = []
    for version in range(count):
        starts, hops = versions[version]
        rendered.append({"starts": [fib.hexbound(x) for x in starts],
                         "hops": hops,
                         "image": images[version].hex})
    return {"versions": rendered, "changes": changes, "bursts": answers,
            "objective": [work, pages]}


def compile_request(cases):
    run_state = [0]
    return {"cases": [compile_case(case, run_state) for case in cases]}


def main():
    try:
        cases = parse_request(sys.stdin.buffer.read(MAX_INPUT + 1))
        result = compile_request(cases)
    except Invalid:
        result = {"error": "invalid"}
    json.dump(result, sys.stdout, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)
    sys.stdout.write("\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Large-R sanity: DP frontier must beat every random legal layout's frontier."""
import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/t')
import planner, ref

def random_layout(R, starts, rng):
    def rec(lo, span):
        if span<=8 and (span<2 or rng.random()<0.35): return ('leaf',lo,span,())
        m=rng.randrange(2,min(9,span)+1)
        cuts=sorted(rng.sample(range(lo+1,lo+span),m-1))
        b=(lo,)+tuple(cuts)+(lo+span,)
        return ('node',lo,span,tuple(rec(x,y-x) for x,y in zip(b,b[1:])))
    return rec(0,R)

def layout_frontier(tree, starts, q, bursts, cap, hit, miss, decode, R):
    qsum=[0]*(R+1)
    for i in range(R): qsum[i+1]=qsum[i]+q[i]
    def T(lo,hi):
        t=0
        for w,runs in bursts:
            if any(lo<=r<hi for r in runs): t+=w
        return t
    nodes=[]
    def walk(nd):
        kind,lo,span,kids=nd
        spread=starts[lo+span-1]-starts[lo]
        modes=[0]
        if spread<(1<<64): modes.append(1)
        if spread<(1<<32): modes.append(2)
        best=None
        for mode in modes:
            if kind=='leaf':
                p=ref._pages(32+span*ref.WIDTH[mode]); keys=span
            else:
                p=ref._pages(32+4*len(kids)+(len(kids)-1)*ref.WIDTH[mode]); keys=len(kids)-1
            b=(keys+ref.LANES[mode]-1)//ref.LANES[mode]+decode[mode]
            t=T(lo,lo+span); qq=qsum[lo+span]-qsum[lo]
            base=p*miss*t+b*qq; gain=p*(miss-hit)*t
            cand=(base,gain,p)
            if best is None or cand<best: best=cand
        nodes.append(best)
        for k in kids: walk(k)
    walk(tree)
    base=sum(n[0] for n in nodes); pages=1+ref._pages(4*R)+sum(n[2] for n in nodes)
    g=[0]*(cap+1)
    for _,gain,p in nodes:
        for c in range(cap,p-1,-1):
            if g[c-p]+gain>g[c]: g[c]=g[c-p]+gain
    for c in range(1,cap+1): g[c]=max(g[c],g[c-1])
    return [(base-g[c], pages) for c in range(cap+1)]

def main():
    seed=int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 1
    rounds=int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 20
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    leaf,inte=None,None
    bad=0
    t0=time.time()
    for it in range(rounds):
        R=rng.randrange(7,65)
        starts=[0]+sorted({rng.randrange(1,1<<rng.choice([30,64,128])) for _ in range(R-1)})
        while len(starts)<R: starts.append(starts[-1]+rng.randrange(1,1<<30))
        starts=starts[:R]
        q=[rng.randrange(0,50) for _ in range(R)]
        bursts=[(rng.randrange(1,1000), sorted({rng.randrange(R) for _ in range(rng.randrange(1,6))}))
                for _ in range(rng.randrange(0,6))]
        cap=rng.randrange(0,13); hit=rng.randrange(1,17); miss=rng.randrange(hit,257)
        decode=[rng.randrange(0,17) for _ in range(3)]
        lo,io=planner.option_tables(decode)
        t=time.time()
        plans=planner.plan_version(R,starts,q,bursts,cap,hit,miss,decode,lo,io)
        dt=time.time()-t
        mine=[(p.work,p.pages+0) for p in plans]
        for _ in range(12):
            tree=random_layout(R,starts,rng)
            rf=layout_frontier(tree,starts,q,bursts,cap,hit,miss,decode,R)
            for c in range(cap+1):
                if mine[c] > rf[c]:
                    bad+=1
                    print("DP WORSE than random layout!", dict(R=R,cap=cap,hit=hit,miss=miss,decode=decode,c=c))
                    print(" mine",mine); print(" rand",rf); break
            if bad: break
        if bad: break
        if dt>8: print("slow", R, "%.1fs"%dt)
    print("rounds",rounds,"bad",bad,"%.1fs"%(time.time()-t0))
main()

"""Deep-tree exactness: mode-0-only instances (huge spread) up to R=9 vs brute force."""
import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/t')
import planner, ref

def layout_cost(nodes, R, starts, q, bursts, hit, miss, decode):
    """Independent recomputation of (work, pages, resident) for a BFS layout."""
    qsum=[0]*(R+1)
    for i in range(R): qsum[i+1]=qsum[i]+q[i]
    def T(lo,hi):
        t=0
        for w,runs in bursts:
            if any(lo<=r<hi for r in runs): t+=w
        return t
    work=0; pages=1+ref._pages(4*R); resident=0
    for kind,mode,cached,lo,span,kids in nodes:
        if kind:
            assert 1<=span<=8 and not kids, nodes
            p=ref._pages(32+span*ref.WIDTH[mode]); keys=span
        else:
            assert 2<=len(kids)<=9
            assert span==sum(nodes[c][4] for c in kids), (span,[nodes[c][4] for c in kids])
            assert lo==nodes[kids[0]][3]
            p=ref._pages(32+4*len(kids)+(len(kids)-1)*ref.WIDTH[mode]); keys=len(kids)-1
        b=(keys+ref.LANES[mode]-1)//ref.LANES[mode]+decode[mode]
        t=T(lo,lo+span)
        work += p*(hit if cached else miss)*t + b*(qsum[lo+span]-qsum[lo])
        pages += p
        if cached: resident += p
    assert nodes[0][3]==0 and nodes[0][4]==R

"""Exact global layout planning: tree shape, encoding modes and residency.

Work model of PROTOCOL.md.  For a node covering runs [i,j) of one version

    work(node) = pages * (hit if cached else miss) * T(i,j)
               + (ceil(keys/lanes[mode]) + decode[mode]) * Q(i,j)

with Q additive over runs and T(burst-weighted touch indicator) monotone in
the covered range.  Every legal ordered tree, every legal mode and every
resident selection is enumerated by one interval dynamic program carrying the
resident-page budget, so the result is the exact per version frontier
(work, image pages) indexed by consumed cache pages.  Versions are then joined
by a small knapsack over the shared page budget of the case.
"""

WIDTH = (16, 8, 4)
LANES = (4, 8, 16)
K1 = 4096                 # encoded value = work * K1 + image pages
BIGV = 1 << 62
LIMIT64 = 1 << 64
LIMIT32 = 1 << 32


def _pages(used):
    return (used + 63) // 64


def option_tables(decode):
    """(pages, compare cost, mode) options, deduplicated, per arity."""
    leaf = []
    for span in range(0, 9):
        per = []
        for allowed in range(3):
            seen = {}
            out = []
            for mode in range(3):
                if mode > allowed:
                    continue
                pages = _pages(32 + span * WIDTH[mode])
                cost = (span + LANES[mode] - 1) // LANES[mode] + decode[mode]
                key = (pages, cost)
                if key not in seen:
                    seen[key] = 1
                    out.append((pages, cost, mode))
            per.append(tuple(out))
        leaf.append(per)
    internal = []
    for count in range(0, 10):
        per = []
        for allowed in range(3):
            seen = {}
            out = []
            if count >= 2:
                keys = count - 1
                for mode in range(3):
                    if mode > allowed:
                        continue
                    pages = _pages(32 + 4 * count + keys * WIDTH[mode])
                    cost = (keys + LANES[mode] - 1) // LANES[mode] + decode[mode]
                    key = (pages, cost)
                    if key not in seen:
                        seen[key] = 1
                        out.append((pages, cost, mode))
            per.append(tuple(out))
        internal.append(per)
    return leaf, internal


def _allowed_mask(starts, i, j):
    spread = starts[j - 1] - starts[i]
    if spread < LIMIT32:
        return 2
    if spread < LIMIT64:
        return 1
    return 0


class Plan:
    """One legal layout of one version plus its exact cost pair."""
    __slots__ = ("nodes", "work", "pages", "resident")

    def __init__(self, nodes, work, pages, resident):
        self.nodes = nodes
        self.work = work
        self.pages = pages
        self.resident = resident


def _traffic(R, qruns, bursts):
    """Q and T for every run interval [i,j)."""
    qsum = [0] * (R + 1)
    acc = 0
    for r in range(R):
        acc += qruns[r]
        qsum[r + 1] = acc
    delta = [[0] * (R + 1) for _ in range(R)]
    for weight, runs in bursts:
        if not runs:
            continue
        n = len(runs)
        pos = 0
        for i in range(R):
            while pos < n and runs[pos] < i:
                pos += 1
            if pos == n:
                break
            delta[i][runs[pos] + 1] += weight
    touch = [[0] * (R + 1) for _ in range(R)]
    for i in range(R):
        row = delta[i]
        out = touch[i]
        acc = 0
        for j in range(i + 1, R + 1):
            acc += row[j]
            out[j] = acc
    return qsum, touch


def plan_version(R, starts, qruns, bursts, budget, hit, miss, decode,
                 leaf_opts, int_opts):
    """Exact frontier of one version: list of Plan for 0..budget pages.

    The returned list is non-decreasing in work; entry p is the cheapest legal
    layout that keeps at most p pages resident inside this version.
    """
    qsum, touch = _traffic(R, qruns, bursts)
    cap = budget
    if cap > 0 and (miss == hit or touch[0][R] == 0):
        cap = 0
    size = R + 1
    dp = [None] * (size * size)
    bp = [None] * (size * size)
    forest_bp = [None] * (8 * size * size)
    masks = [[0] * size for _ in range(size)]
    for i in range(R):
        for j in range(i + 1, R + 1):
            masks[i][j] = _allowed_mask(starts, i, j)

    for i in range(R - 1, -1, -1):
        forests = [[None] * size for _ in range(10)]
        for j in range(i + 1, R + 1):
            length = j - i
            queries = qsum[j] - qsum[i]
            touched = touch[i][j]
            mask = masks[i][j]
            limit = 9 if length >= 9 else length
            base = i * size + j
            for m in range(2, limit + 1):
                best = [BIGV] * (cap + 1)
                bestk = [0] * (cap + 1)
                seen = False
                for k in range(i + m - 1, j):
                    left = forests[m - 1][k]
                    if left is None:
                        continue
                    right = dp[k * size + j]
                    if right[0] >= BIGV:
                        continue
                    seen = True
                    for c1 in range(cap + 1):
                        a = left[c1]
                        hi = cap - c1
                        for c2 in range(hi + 1):
                            value = a + right[c2]
                            slot = c1 + c2
                            if value < best[slot]:
                                best[slot] = value
                                bestk[slot] = k * (cap + 1) + c1
                if seen:
                    forests[m][j] = best
                    forest_bp[((m - 2) * size + i) * size + j] = bestk
            vec = [BIGV] * (cap + 1)
            choice = [None] * (cap + 1)
            if length <= 8:
                for pages, cost, mode in leaf_opts[length][mask]:
                    compare = cost * queries
                    loose = (pages * miss * touched + compare) * K1 + pages
                    kept = (pages * hit * touched + compare) * K1 + pages
                    top = pages if pages <= cap else cap + 1
                    for c in range(top):
                        if loose < vec[c]:
                            vec[c] = loose
                            choice[c] = (1, mode, 0, 0, 0)
                    if pages <= cap:
                        for c in range(pages, cap + 1):
                            if kept < vec[c]:
                                vec[c] = kept
                                choice[c] = (1, mode, 1, 0, 0)
            for m in range(2, limit + 1):
                forest = forests[m][j]
                if forest is None:
                    continue
                for pages, cost, mode in int_opts[m][mask]:
                    compare = cost * queries
                    loose = (pages * miss * touched + compare) * K1 + pages
                    kept = (pages * hit * touched + compare) * K1 + pages
                    for c in range(cap + 1):
                        value = forest[c] + loose
                        if value < vec[c]:
                            vec[c] = value
                            choice[c] = (0, mode, 0, m, c)
                    if pages <= cap:
                        for c in range(pages, cap + 1):
                            value = forest[c - pages] + kept
                            if value < vec[c]:
                                vec[c] = value
                                choice[c] = (0, mode, 1, m, c - pages)
            for c in range(1, cap + 1):
                if vec[c] > vec[c - 1]:
                    vec[c] = vec[c - 1]
                    choice[c] = choice[c - 1]
            dp[base] = vec
            bp[base] = choice
            forests[1][j] = vec

    root = dp[R]
    plans = []
    for c in range(cap + 1):
        value = root[c]
        work, pages = divmod(value, K1)
        plans.append(_rebuild(c, 0, R, bp, forest_bp, size, cap, work, pages))
    if cap < budget:
        plans.extend([plans[-1]] * (budget - cap))
    return plans


def _node_pages(kind, mode, count):
    """count is the run span of a leaf, the child count of an internal node."""
    if kind:
        return _pages(32 + count * WIDTH[mode])
    return _pages(32 + 4 * count + (count - 1) * WIDTH[mode])


def _rebuild(c, i, j, bp, forest_bp, size, cap, work, pages):
    """Materialize the optimal layout recorded for run range [i,j) and budget c."""
    kind_of = []
    lo_of = []
    span_of = []
    kids_of = []

    def walk(a, b, budget):
        index = len(kind_of)
        kind_of.append(-1)
        lo_of.append(a)
        span_of.append(b - a)
        kids_of.append(())
        kind, mode, cached, count, child_budget = bp[a * size + b][budget]

"""FIDX version 2 image serialization, packed lookup and work accounting."""
import struct
from bisect import bisect_right

WIDTH = (16, 8, 4)
LANES = (4, 8, 16)
NULL_HOP = 0xffffffff
PACK_BBBB_HHHH_I = struct.Struct("<BBBBHHHHI")
PACK_I = struct.Struct("<I")


class Node:
    __slots__ = ("kind", "mode", "cached", "lo", "span", "children", "keys",
                 "pages", "offset", "key_count")

    def __init__(self, kind, mode, cached, lo, span, children, keys, pages):
        self.kind = kind
        self.mode = mode
        self.cached = cached
        self.lo = lo
        self.span = span
        self.children = children
        self.keys = keys
        self.pages = pages
        self.offset = 0
        self.key_count = len(keys)


class Image:
    __slots__ = ("nodes", "by_offset", "hex", "pages", "total", "hop_offset")

    def __init__(self, nodes, by_offset, text, pages, total, hop_offset):
        self.nodes = nodes
        self.by_offset = by_offset
        self.hex = text
        self.pages = pages
        self.total = total
        self.hop_offset = hop_offset


def used_bytes(kind, mode, count):
    """count is the run span of a leaf, the child count of an internal node."""
    if kind:
        return 32 + count * WIDTH[mode]
    return 32 + 4 * count + (count - 1) * WIDTH[mode]


def build(runs, starts, hops, layout):
    """Serialize one version image from a breadth-first ordered layout."""
    count = len(layout)
    nodes = []
    sizes = []
    for kind, mode, cached, lo, span, kids in layout:
        allocated = (used_bytes(kind, mode, span if kind else len(kids)) + 63) // 64 * 64
        sizes.append(allocated)
        if kind:
            keys = starts[lo:lo + span]
        else:
            keys = [starts[layout[c][3]] for c in kids[1:]]
        nodes.append(Node(kind, mode, cached, lo, span, tuple(kids), keys,
                          allocated // 64))
    offset = 64
    for node, size in zip(nodes, sizes):
        node.offset = offset
        offset += size
    hop_offset = offset
    total = hop_offset + (runs * 4 + 63) // 64 * 64
    buffer = bytearray(total)
    buffer[0:4] = b"FIDX"
    buffer[4] = 2
    struct.pack_into("<IIII", buffer, 8, runs, count, hop_offset, total)
    for node, size in zip(nodes, sizes):
        at = node.offset
        count_field = node.span if node.kind else len(node.children)
        PACK_BBBB_HHHH_I.pack_into(buffer, at, node.kind, node.mode,
                                   node.cached, 0, node.lo, node.span,
                                   count_field, 0, size)
        buffer[at + 16:at + 32] = starts[node.lo].to_bytes(16, "little")
        cursor = at + 32
        if not node.kind:
            for child in node.children:
                PACK_I.pack_into(buffer, cursor, nodes[child].offset)
                cursor += 4
        width = WIDTH[node.mode]
        if node.mode:
            base = starts[node.lo]
            for key in node.keys:
                buffer[cursor:cursor + width] = (key - base).to_bytes(width, "little")
                cursor += width
        else:
            for key in node.keys:
                buffer[cursor:cursor + width] = key.to_bytes(width, "little")
                cursor += width
    for index, hop in enumerate(hops):
        PACK_I.pack_into(buffer, hop_offset + 4 * index,
                         NULL_HOP if hop is None else hop)
    by_offset = {node.offset: node for node in nodes}
    return Image(nodes, by_offset, buffer.hex(), total // 64, total, hop_offset)


def lookup(image, address):
    """Actual packed traversal: root to leaf byte offsets plus the run."""
    nodes = image.nodes
    path = []
    index = 0
    while True:
        node = nodes[index]
        path.append(node.offset)
        if node.kind:
            run = node.lo + bisect_right(node.keys, address) - 1
            return run, path
        index = node.children[bisect_right(node.keys, address)]


def burst_answers(image, hops, addresses):
    out = []
    for address in addresses:
        run, path = lookup(image, address)
        out.append([hops[run], run, path])
    return out


def burst_work(image, costs, repeat, addresses):
    """Auditor-identical work accumulation for one burst of one version."""
    hit, miss, decode = costs
    nodes = image.nodes
    visits = {}
    touched = []
    for address in addresses:
        index = 0
        while True:
            node = nodes[index]
            seen = visits.get(node.offset)
            if seen is None:
                visits[node.offset] = 1
                touched.append(node)
            else:
                visits[node.offset] = seen + 1
            if node.kind:
                break
            index = node.children[bisect_right(node.keys, address)]
    work = 0
    for node in touched:
        keys = node.key_count
        compare = (keys + LANES[node.mode] - 1) // LANES[node.mode] + decode[node.mode]
        fetch = node.pages * (hit if node.cached else miss)
        work += repeat * (fetch + compare * visits[node.offset])
    return work

"""Cache-budgeted IPv6 image compiler: exact globally optimal packed images."""
import json
import sys
from bisect import bisect_right

import fib
import image
import planner
from protocol import Invalid, MAX_INPUT, parse_request

BIGV = 1 << 62
MAX_RUNS = 64
MAX_TOTAL_RUNS = 128


def build_versions(case):
    """Apply the ordered transactions, keeping every immutable FIB version."""
    routes = {}
    for route, hop in case["initial"]:
        routes[route] = hop
    versions = [fib.compile_runs(routes)]
    for transaction in case["transactions"]:
        for op, route, hop in transaction:
            if op == "set":
                routes[route] = hop
            else:
                routes.pop(route, None)
        versions.append(fib.compile_runs(routes))
    return versions


def compile_case(case, run_state):
    versions = build_versions(case)
    for starts, _ in versions:
        if len(starts) > MAX_RUNS:
            raise Invalid("forwarding run budget")
        run_state[0] += len(starts)
        if run_state[0] > MAX_TOTAL_RUNS:
            raise Invalid("forwarding run budget")
    hit, miss, decode = case["costs"]
    cap = case["cache_pages"]
    count = len(versions)
    qruns = [[0] * len(v[0]) for v in versions]
    touched = [[] for _ in range(count)]
    workload = []
    for version, repeat, addresses in case["bursts"]:
        starts = versions[version][0]
        runs = [bisect_right(starts, address) - 1 for address in addresses]
        workload.append((version, repeat, addresses, runs))
        counts = {}
        for run in runs:
            counts[run] = counts.get(run, 0) + 1
        for run, seen in counts.items():
            qruns[version][run] += repeat * seen
        touched[version].append((repeat, sorted(counts)))
    leaf_opts, int_opts = planner.option_tables(decode)
    plans = [planner.plan_version(len(versions[v][0]), versions[v][0],
                                  qruns[v], touched[v], cap, hit, miss, decode,
                                  leaf_opts, int_opts)
             for v in range(count)]

def build_versions(case):
    """Apply the ordered transactions, keeping every immutable FIB version."""
    routes = {}
    for route, hop in case["initial"]:
        routes[route] = hop
    versions = [fib.compile_runs(routes)]
    for transaction in case["transactions"]:

            else:

"""Cache-budgeted IPv6 image compiler: exact globally optimal packed images."""
import json
import sys
from bisect import bisect_right

import fib
import image
import planner
from protocol import Invalid, MAX_INPUT, parse_request

BIGV = 1 << 62
MAX_RUNS = 64
MAX_TOTAL_RUNS = 128


def build_versions(case):
    """Apply the ordered transactions, keeping every immutable FIB version."""
    routes = {}
    for route, hop in case["initial"]:
        routes[route] = hop
    versions = [fib.compile_runs(routes)]
    for transaction in case["transactions"]:
        for op, route, hop in transaction:
            if op == "set":
                routes[route] = hop
            else:
                routes.pop(route, None)
        versions.append(fib.compile_runs(routes))
    return versions


def compile_case(case, run_state):
    versions = build_versions(case)
    for starts, _ in versions:
        if len(starts) > MAX_RUNS:
            raise Invalid("forwarding run budget")
        run_state[0] += len(starts)
        if run_state[0] > MAX_TOTAL_RUNS:
            raise Invalid("forwarding run budget")
    hit, miss, decode = case["costs"]
    cap = case["cache_pages"]
    count = len(versions)
    qruns = [[0] * len(v[0]) for v in versions]
    touched = [[] for _ in range(count)]
    workload = []
    for version, repeat, addresses in case["bursts"]:
        starts = versions[version][0]
        runs = [bisect_right(starts, address) - 1 for address in addresses]
        workload.append((version, repeat, addresses, runs))
        counts = {}
        for run in runs:
            counts[run] = counts.get(run, 0) + 1
        for run, seen in counts.items():
            qruns[version][run] += repeat * seen
        touched[version].append((repeat, sorted(counts)))
    leaf_opts, int_opts = planner.option_tables(decode)
    plans = [planner.plan_version(len(versions[v][0]), versions[v][0],
                                  qruns[v], touched[v], cap, hit, miss, decode,
                                  leaf_opts, int_opts)
             for v in range(count)]

    # Shared resident page budget across all immutable versions of this case.
    comb = [(0, 0, ())] + [(BIGV, 0, ())] * cap
    for version in range(count):
        table = plans[version]
        nxt = [(BIGV, 0, ())] * (cap + 1)
        for total in range(cap + 1):
            best = nxt[total]
            for keep in range(total + 1):
                previous = comb[total - keep]
                if previous[0] >= BIGV:
                    continue
                plan = table[keep]
                work = previous[0] + plan.work
                pages = previous[1] + plan.pages
                if work < best[0] or (work == best[0] and pages < best[1]):
                    best = (work, pages, previous[2] + (keep,))
            nxt[total] = best
        comb = nxt
    pick = min(range(cap + 1), key=lambda c: (comb[c][0], comb[c][1]))
    allocation = comb[pick][2]

    images = []
    for version in range(count):
        starts, hops = versions[version]
        images.append(image.build(len(starts), starts, hops,
                                  plans[version][allocation[version]].nodes))
    answers = []
    work = 0
    for version, repeat, addresses, runs in workload:
        rendered = image.burst_answers(images[version], versions[version][1],
                                       addresses)
        answers.append(rendered)
        work += image.burst_work(images[version], case["costs"], repeat,
                                 addresses)
    pages = sum(item.pages for item in images)
    if sum(plans[v][allocation[v]].resident for v in range(count)) > cap:
        raise Invalid("resident budget exceeded")
    changes = []
    for version in range(count - 1):
        rows = fib.diff_runs(versions[version], versions[version + 1])
        changes.append([[fib.hexbound(a), fib.hexbound(b), old, new]
                        for a, b, old, new in rows])
    rendered = []
    for version in range(count):
        starts, hops = versions[version]
        rendered.append({"starts": [fib.hexbound(x) for x in starts],
                         "hops": hops,
                         "image": images[version].hex})
    return {"versions": rendered, "changes": changes, "bursts": answers,
            "objective": [work, pages]}


def compile_request(cases):
    run_state = [0]
    return {"cases": [compile_case(case, run_state) for case in cases]}


def main():
    try:
        cases = parse_request(sys.stdin.buffer.read(MAX_INPUT + 1))
        result = compile_request(cases)
    except Invalid:
        result = {"error": "invalid"}
    except Exception:                       # pragma: no cover - safety net
        result = {"error": "invalid"}       # never emit a partial answer
    json.dump(result, sys.stdout, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)
    sys.stdout.write("\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
